children: REG-SCHOUW & CO. CLOSES THE ACQUISITION OF SPECTRE AND ADJUST REVENUE GUIDANCE ACCORDINGLY
2026 FULL-YEAR REVENUE IS NOW EXPECTED IN RANGE OF DKK 35.1-37.6 BILLION AGAINST PREVIOUSLY DKK 34.8-37.2 BILLION
EXPECTATIONS FOR 2026 FULL-YEAR EBITDA REMAINS IN RANGE DKK 3.150-3.350 MILLION
SPECTRE EXPECTS A FULL-YEAR 2026 REVENUE OF ABOUT DKK 1 BILLION AND AN EBITDA MARGIN OF 15-17%.
